description: getDomainInfo: Get registry (EPP) state plus account settings for one domain: status, nameservers, lock state, auto-renew, privacy, creation/expiry dates, premium/expired/redemption info. Dates are null while a registration is still pending at the registry; autoRenew is omitted for transferredOut domains.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name, like "example.com", without scheme.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getDomainInfo
